Plan events across several days, find places as you type, and keep calendar text out of the process list.

![OmaCal's calendar and quick-add form](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/crmne/omacal/v1.1.0/preview.png)

## New

- **Events can span several days.** Give the last day under **until**, using a date, `sun`, or `+2`. The end time falls on that day, and moving the start carries the span with it. By @crmne.
- **Where? suggests places.** With a Google Maps key, suggestions come from Google Places. Without one, they come from OpenStreetMap through Komoot's Photon service. Typed location text is sent to the selected provider. Set a Places API (New) key in OmaCal's settings; it is stored in `~/.config/omacal/google-places-key`. Turn **Suggest places** off to stop these requests. By @crmne.
- **Each end can keep its own time zone.** A Berlin-to-New York flight now stores both zones directly in HEY, without converting the end onto the start's clock. By @crmne.

![A three-day event with synthetic place suggestions](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/crmne/omacal/v1.1.0/screenshots/quick-add.png)

## Fixed

- **Event titles, places and track names stay out of process arguments.** Creates, edits and track renames now go directly to HEY over HTTPS, using a token read from hey-cli's stdout and kept in memory. Edits carry forward existing reminders, links, attached emails, note text and countdowns. By @crmne; thanks @HANCORE-linux for reporting the command-line exposure in [marketplace #9294](https://github.com/omacom/omarchy-plugin-marketplace/issues/9294).
- **Text fields read the clipboard only when you paste.** Fields now handle keys themselves, with bounded clipboard reads only on `Ctrl+V` or `Shift+Insert`. Native Qt text inputs could read another application's clipboard automatically, even while hidden. By @crmne; thanks @HANCORE-linux for identifying this during plugin reviews.

## Known limitations

- **Editing keeps note text but loses formatting.** HEY's API returns notes as plain text. Use HEY for edits where the original note formatting must stay intact.
- **Some changes are still HEY's.** The form cannot remove every reminder, change notes, guests or repeats, or move a whole series to another day. An unreadable countdown or a stored time that cannot be preserved also needs HEY.
- **Text entry has keyboard limitations.** Compose/dead keys, IME input and mouse selection are not supported yet.
- **The editor opens times on this machine's clock.** Saving new times uses the zones shown in the form.

## Install

```sh
omarchy plugin add https://github.com/crmne/omacal.git --enable
omarchy plugin disable omarchy.clock
```

Already installed: `omarchy plugin update crmne.omacal`.
